description: Xenitronix Bypass v9.1 — HTTPS MITM Proxy with TLS interception, UID checking and Discord bot. Port: 2039.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Xenitronix Bypass v9.1 — Pterodactyl Install Script
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

set -e

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl unzip build-essential cmake pkg-config libssl-dev git

# Install Rust if not present
if ! command -v cargo &> /dev/null; then
  echo "[*] Installing Rust..."
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
  source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
else
  source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
  echo "[*] Rust already installed: $(rustc --version)"
fi

# If source zip was uploaded, extract it
if [ -f /mnt/server/xenitronix_src.zip ]; then
  echo "[*] Extracting source..."
  cd /mnt/server
  unzip -o xenitronix_src.zip -d /tmp/xenitronix_build
  SRC_DIR=$(find /tmp/xenitronix_build -name 'Cargo.toml' -maxdepth 3 | head -1 | xargs dirname)
  echo "[*] Building release binary from $SRC_DIR..."
  cd "$SRC_DIR"
  cargo build --release
  cp target/release/xenitronix /mnt/server/xenitronix
  chmod +x /mnt/server/xenitronix
  rm -rf /tmp/xenitronix_build
  echo "[+] Build complete!"
else
  echo "[!] No source zip found."
  echo "    Upload xenitronix_src.zip to the server files via the panel"
  echo "    then reinstall, OR upload a pre-compiled 'xenitronix' Linux binary."
fi

# Create default .env if missing
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.env ]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/.env << 'ENVEOF'
DISCORD_TOKEN=
RUST_LOG=info
ENVEOF
  echo "[+] Default .env created — fill in DISCORD_TOKEN via File Manager"
fi

echo ""
echo "══════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "  Xenitronix Install Complete"
echo "══════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "  Next steps:"
echo "  1. Upload mitmproxy-ca.pem via File Manager"
echo "  2. Set DISCORD_TOKEN in .env"
echo "  3. Start the server"
echo "══════════════════════════════════════════"
